source: Synthetic snapshots in the isolated native session store. No prompts or approvals sent.
results: Restored Deck counts update on History before Deck has been mounted
Counts expose a complete accessible status summary and hover hint
Only Deck agent Tabs count; unrelated running agents, idle, files, and drafts are excluded
Background completion moves running to unread without opening Deck
Pending input takes priority over running and old unread
Failure takes priority over running and unread
Running takes priority over an old unread flag
An active turn counts as running while lifecycle metadata still says idle
Permission counts produce the same input state as the Tab strip
Sidebar state updates add no conversation timeline subscriptions
Observing unread counts never marks an agent as read
Opening Deck preserves counts across splits
Updating counts preserves the active composer instance
Closing a file does not change agent status counts
Closing an unread Tab removes its count and hides the zero state
Counts remain readable in dark and light themes
Reduced motion retains the native running indicator and counts
The visible 375px sidebar retains all counts after leaving Deck, without overflow
Landscape navigation keeps the same counts
All idle states remove the count area completely
